The '''Red Rug''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|1000}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

One Red Rug is obtained when the [[Farmhouse|Bedroom]] is redecorated by [[Penny]] in her [[Penny#Fourteen Hearts|14-Heart]] event, choosing Strawberry Home.
